label: Synthetic engineering benchmark; fictional profiles; author-defined labels; not independent human validation, customer traction, or a production usage study.
annotationPolicy: Expected labels were written before any hosted-model run. Acceptable means the profile explicitly offers the requested kind of help and meets every hard constraint. Unsupported credentials, availability, location, or mere topic interest are insufficient. Positive cases need at least one acceptable recommendation and no unacceptable recommendation; returning every acceptable profile is not required. Negative cases require no recommendation. All non-acceptable handles in the declared candidate pool are explicitly unacceptable.

baseline.name: BM25 lexical baseline
baseline.description: Frozen heuristic thresholds, not tuned on these case labels or a live run. Case-insensitive Unicode tokens, English stopword removal and conservative English suffix normalization; no embeddings or translation. Standard BM25 across combined public profile fields; maximum three candidates above evidence and relative-score thresholds.
